welcome.title: Let's set up your command center
welcome.subtitle: GoWorks lets you manage Google Workspace from a single panel. We'll need three things below.

admin.title: Workspace Super Admin
admin.body: An account with full admin access is required to authorize the service account.

cloud.title: Google Cloud project
cloud.body: We'll open a Cloud project to create a Service Account and enable Workspace APIs.

duration.title: 5–10 minutes
duration.body: You can pause between steps any time; your progress is saved.

branding.title: Introduce your organization
branding.subtitle: These details power the header, sidebar, and outgoing emails. The preview on the right updates with every keystroke.

companyName.label: Company name
companyName.hint: Appears in the sidebar header and as the email sender label.

sidebarAbbr.label: Sidebar abbreviation
sidebarAbbr.hint: If left empty, it is generated from the company name initials. Preview: {{preview}}

allowedDomain.label: Allowed email domain
allowedDomain.hint: Only Google accounts ending with this domain may sign in.

emailSenderName.label: Email sender name
emailSenderName.hint: Sender label used on bulk-job notification emails.

logo.title: Logo
logo.hint: PNG / JPG / SVG / WEBP, max 1 MB
logo.tooLarge: Logo file exceeds the 1 MB limit
logo.invalidFormat: Only PNG, JPG, SVG or WEBP are allowed
logo.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete the logo?

cloud.title: Create a Google Cloud project
cloud.subtitle: The Service Account and API permissions will live here. You can either create a new project or use an existing one.

instructions.title: Open Cloud Console
instructions.body: Go to console.cloud.google.com and sign in with your super-admin account.

instructions.title: Create a new project
instructions.body: Use the project picker at the top → "New project" → name it for GoWorks.

instructions.title: Enable APIs
instructions.body: Search for and enable the APIs listed on the right one by one.

instructions.title: Configure the consent screen
instructions.body: APIs & Services → OAuth consent screen → choose User Type Internal → enter app name and support email. Internal apps need no Google verification or test users.

instructions.title: Ready for the next step
instructions.body: Once the consent screen is set, you can move on to the Service Account step.

cloud.tip: Tip: type the full API name in the search box — multiple APIs share similar prefixes.

credentials.title: OAuth Client ID and Secret
credentials.subtitle: Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials → "Create OAuth client ID" → type "Desktop app". Paste the two values you receive here. The secret is stored encrypted on this device via the OS keychain (Keychain / DPAPI).
credentials.clientIdHint: Copy from the OAuth 2.0 Client ID list in Cloud Console.
credentials.clientSecretHint: Stored only on this device, encrypted via the OS keychain.
credentials.clientSecretRotateHint: Existing secret is kept. Typing a new value overwrites it.
credentials.clearConfirm: Are you sure you want to remove the stored OAuth credentials? You'll have to re-enter them via the wizard on next launch.

serviceAccount.title: Service Account key
serviceAccount.subtitle: Create a Service Account in your Cloud project, download the JSON key, and upload it below. The key is stored locally on this device.
serviceAccount.dropzoneTitle: Drop the JSON key here or click to browse
serviceAccount.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to delete the Service Account key?
serviceAccount.guideHint: If you haven't created the JSON yet: Cloud Console → IAM → Service Accounts → create new → "Keys" tab → add JSON-format key.

errors.notJson: Please choose a .json Service Account key file

dwd.title: Domain-Wide Delegation
dwd.subtitle: Authorize the Service Account in Admin Console with the Client ID and scope list below so it can act on behalf of admins.
dwd.clientIdMissing: Upload the Service Account JSON first to display its Client ID.
dwd.instructions: In Admin Console go to "API controls" → "Domain-wide delegation" → "Add new", paste the Client ID, and provide the OAuth scopes as a comma-separated single line.
dwd.testFailHelp: Could not read admin.directory.user as {{adminEmail}}. Re-check the Client ID and scope list in Admin Console — most likely one or more scopes are missing or unauthorized. Make sure the Service Account's Client ID and all OAuth scopes above are fully authorized.
dwd.skipConfirm: Continue without configuring DWD? Gmail signature push won't work — you can finish setup later from Settings.

adminLogin.title: Admin sign-in
adminLogin.subtitle: Sign in with your super-admin Google account. We'll test Domain-Wide Delegation in the next step.
adminLogin.googleCta: Sign in as admin with Google
adminLogin.loginInProgress: Google window opened in your browser...
adminLogin.footnote: OAuth will open in your browser.

completion.title: You're ready to go!
completion.subtitle: Pre-setup is complete. You can now start using the GoWorks panel.
completion.dwdPending: Domain-Wide Delegation pending — finish from Settings → General
completion.resetNote: You can re-run the wizard any time from Settings → General.

errors.needServiceAccount: Upload the Service Account JSON key first.
errors.needBranding: Fill in the company name and allowed domain before continuing.
errors.needDwdTest: Run the DWD test successfully before continuing.
errors.needCredentials: Save the Google OAuth Client ID and Secret before continuing.
